understanding: Implement passive XZ protocol checks flagging X or Z on WISHBONE responder ports RS232 serial pads and modem handshake signals on default clock sampling with immediate error, depending on established bus serial and modem monitor sampling.
preconditions: wishbone_bus passive monitor sampling established for DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 responder
serial_data passive monitor sampling established for stx_pad_o tx and srx_pad_i rx
modem_control passive observer sampling established for rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i
common clock stable and reset at symbolic inactive level with monitors driving nothing
check_steps: SAMPLE wishbone_bus ports wb_adr_i wb_sel_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o in monitor on SYM_CLK_DEFAULT_EDGE while reset inactive
IF any sampled wishbone_bus bit is X or Z THEN FLAG immediate protocol error for wishbone_bus XZ
SAMPLE serial_data ports stx_pad_o srx_pad_i in monitor on SYM_CLK_DEFAULT_EDGE while reset inactive
IF any sampled serial_data bit is X or Z THEN FLAG immediate protocol error for serial_data XZ
SAMPLE modem_control ports rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i in observer on SYM_CLK_DEFAULT_EDGE while reset inactive
IF any sampled modem_control bit is X or Z THEN FLAG immediate protocol error for modem_control XZ
GATE all XZ flagging while reset asserted per symbolic SYM_RESET_GATING without assuming polarity or idle levels
completion: WAIT for monitor XZ evaluations to settle and event queues to drain within TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit not DUT timing
CLEANUP release monitor observation handles with monitors driving nothing
